title: Lost Horizons: The Photography of George Webber
original_title: Lost Horizons: The Photography of George Webber
overview: Internationally renowned Canadian photographer George Webber delves into the little-known lives and stories of vanishing Western prairie towns. Returning to the same areas over several decades, Webber has created a remarkable black and white archive of Canada's changing landscapes.
